thread:
jamal: FYI getting a support escalation — hosted-inference p99 timeouts and 5xx spike in usw2. multiple customers reporting failed requests (5xx) + elevated SLO burn. opening thread to correlate logs/traces.
maria: Thanks. Which route? any auth failures?
jamal: Mostly /v1/generate and /v1/stream. Auth looks green for most calls, but there's a bump in 401s for a subset. 5xx are mostly 502/504 from gateway. Dashboards show a p99 jump at 13:12 UTC.
alex: Pushing the usual queries. Datadog: 
```
avg:last_5m:trace.requests{service:hosted-infer,region:usw2}.rollup(max)
```
Got spike there. Probe vs real traffic diverge too.
lina: Checking traces — gap in X-Request-ID sampling around 13:10-13:20. Many traces end at ingress with no backend spans. Could be gateway handshake or TLS handshake backlog.
jamal: Support notes: customer A saw 502 with body: "upstream connection reset" and customer B saw 504 after 30s timeout.
maria: Can you run this logs query in Loki for the window?
```
{job="ingress"} |~ "upstream .* reset|handshake" | json | sort_desc timestamp | limit 200
```
alex: Ran it — repeated pattern: many `connect() to 10.0.*:* failed: connection timed out` and a cluster of `ratewindow exceeded` from authz-proxy. Strange correlation between auth ratewindow and gateway backlog.
lina: Also found rate limiter errors like: `429 backend: ratewindow` then downstream service returns 502 when queued requests exceed pool. Might be cascading.
jamal: Could be a short-lived authz service GC pause or a misconfigured ratewindow TTL. Any deploys around 13:00?
deploy-bot: deploys: service=authz-proxy image=authz:v2.14.1 user=ci-bot started=2026-03-17T12:58:46Z finished=2026-03-17T12:59:12Z
maria: That aligns. Rollout could have dropped connection pool sizes temporarily. Can we repro in staging with a burst test?
alex: Spinning up a canary load in staging against authz:v2.14.1 with simultaneous 10k qps small requests + long-holding streaming requests to see backlog.
jamal: Meanwhile, add a temporary route-level fallback to model-variant low-latency pool and enable `graceful_reject` at gateway (shorter queue) to protect customers.
lina: Also open an alert to increase trace sample for that window and capture connection-level logs (`tcpdump`) for 5 minutes.
maria: I've configured a short-lived dashboard with these panels: ingress queue depth, authz error rate, backend conn errors, p99 per-route. Link: https://dash.redwood.local/d/xyz/incident-usw2-5xx (private)
jamal: Support notified customers with note: we're investigating and will follow up.
support-bot: Ticket #C-2026-117 opened, linked to this thread.
alex: Initial hypothesis: authz upgrade reduced conn pool or introduced short GC pauses causing authz to return 429s -> gateway queues up -> upstream hits timeout -> 502/504. Repro pending in staging.
maria: Action items: 1) rollback authz if staging repro matches, 2) enable graceful_reject on gateway 3) increase authz connection pool and monitor GC flags 4) collect tcpdump & increased trace sampling.
jamal: Assigning owners: rollback=alex, gateway-fallback=maria, traces/tcpdump=lina. I'll keep support updated.
lina: collecting tcpdump now, will post capture link when done.
jamal: thanks, everyone. Will update when we have staging repro or rollback. :thumbsup:
